decks.notes: The deck focuses on controlling the game by countering opponent's spells, disrupting their strategy, and generating card advantage through draw spells like Impulse and Accumulated Knowledge. It also uses versatile threat like Morphling and removal like Nevinyrral's Disk to handle various situations. With a mix of counterspells, bounce spells, and card draw, the deck aims to outlast opponents and win the game through attrition and strategic plays. The lands in the deck provide flexibility and utility, allowing the player to adapt to different board states and opponent's actions.

The main focus of this Aggro Goblin deck is to quickly flood the board with Goblin creatures using Goblin Lackey and Goblin Matron to search for key pieces like Goblin Ringleader and Goblin Warchief. This deck aims to apply pressure early on with fast and efficient creatures like Goblin Piledriver and Mogg Fanatic, backed up by removal spells like Gempalm Incinerator and Wasteland to disrupt the opponent's strategy. The inclusion of cards like Siege-Gang Commander and Goblin Sharpshooter provide additional reach and utility to keep up the pressure and secure victory.

The main focus of this deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan through a combination of hand disruption, land destruction, and removal spells. By using cards like Vindicate, Duress, and Gerrard's Verdict, the deck aims to control the board and limit the opponent's resources. Additionally, the deck includes powerful spells such as Decree of Justice and Wrath of God to maintain board presence and stabilize the game. With a mix of removal, disruption, and threat cards like Eternal Dragon and Exalted Angel, this BW Control deck looks to outlast and outvalue its opponents in a grindy matchup.

The focus of this deck is to quickly assemble the necessary pieces to pull off the Tinker Fling combo, using cards like Oath of Druids, Altar of Dementia, and Defense Grid for protection. By efficiently ramping up mana with cards like Lotus Petal and Ancient Tomb, the deck is able to set up the combo quickly and efficiently. City of Traitors and Crystal Vein further support this strategy, while cards like Impulse and Intuition help in finding key combo pieces. Tsabo's Web and City of Brass provide additional utility and flexibility.

The deck focuses on using enchantments to create a powerful combo that can overwhelm opponents. By utilizing cards like Sterling Grove, Serra's Sanctum, and Enchantress's Presence, the goal is to generate a large amount of mana and card advantage. This enables the player to play powerful enchantments like Opalescence and Replenish, which can quickly close out the game. With cards like Parallax Wave and Solitary Confinement to control the board and protect the combo, the deck aims to establish dominance and win before the opponent can effectively respond.

This deck focuses on using enchantments to create a powerful combo that allows the player to control the game. By utilizing cards like Enchantress's Presence and Mirri's Guile to draw more cards and generate more mana, the player can quickly set up a board state with multiple enchantments. Cards like Opalescence and Parallax Wave provide ways to control the battlefield and disrupt the opponent's strategy. With the ability to quickly replenish their enchantments with cards like Replenish, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a powerful enchantress engine.

The main focus of this deck is to deal quick, consistent damage to the opponent using cheap and efficient burn spells and aggressive creatures like Mogg Fanatic. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent early on with a combination of direct damage and pressure from its creatures, all while minimizing the impact of its own life total with cards like Price of Progress and Fireblast. By maintaining a steady stream of damage output, this deck aims to close out the game swiftly before the opponent has a chance to stabilize.

This deck focuses on aggressive, fast-paced gameplay using cheap, efficient burn spells and aggressive creatures to quickly reduce the opponent's life total to zero. With a low mana curve and plenty of direct damage spells, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent before they can stabilize and mount a defense. The goal is to maintain pressure on the opponent and keep them on the defensive, using a combination of creatures and burn spells to finish them off quickly.

The main idea of this deck is to quickly generate mana through cards like Dark Ritual and Lotus Petal, while using Ill-Gotten Gains to recur key combo pieces like Brain Freeze and Lion's Eye Diamond. Intuition allows for powerful tutor effects, while the deck also includes disruption in the form of Arcane Denial and Tormod's Crypt. The goal is to set up a massive Brain Freeze spell to mill out the opponent, with cards like Deep Analysis to dig for combo pieces and Infernal Contract for additional card advantage. The deck focuses on quickly assembling its combo pieces and disrupting the opponent's game plan.

The main idea of this deck is to use Stasis along with various control elements to disrupt the opponent's game plan and win through a combo finish. By denying the opponent resources with Stasis and maintaining control with counterspells and bounce spells, the deck aims to buy enough time to assemble the combo pieces needed for victory. The inclusion of cards like Thwart and Chain of Vapor adds flexibility and disruption to the deck's game plan, while cards like Black Vise and Root Maze provide additional pressure and utility.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly and aggressively deal damage to the opponent by using low-cost, efficient creatures and burn spells. It aims to overwhelm the opponent's defenses and finish the game before they are able to stabilize. The deck relies on a combination of creature and direct damage spells to continually apply pressure and prevent the opponent from gaining the upper hand. The mana base is designed to support the deck's fast-paced strategy and ensure consistent access to the necessary colors of mana.

The deck revolves around the powerful creature Psychatog, utilizing its ability to grow in size by discarding cards. The main focus is to control the game through countering spells, hand disruption with Duress, and card draw. The deck also includes removal spells like Smother and Shadowmage Infiltrator for additional control. With a mix of counterspells, card draw, and creature threats, the deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver opponents in a slower-paced, more strategic game.

The deck focuses on using Survival of the Fittest to search for key creatures that disrupt the opponent's game plan and provide value. The control elements like Swords to Plowshares and Vindicate help manage threats while cards like Cabal Therapy and Withered Wretch disrupt the opponent's hand and graveyard. The deck also includes card advantage engines like Monk Realist and Sylvan Library to help maintain resources. The mana base is constructed to support the color requirements of the deck while cards like Wall of Blossoms provide early defense.

The focus of this deck is to quickly assemble the combo of Phyrexian Dreadnought and Stifle to create a powerful threat that is difficult for opponents to deal with. The deck includes key cards such as Opt, Counterspell, and Impulse to help dig for combo pieces and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The inclusion of Vision Charm and Brain Freeze also provide additional utility and potential win conditions. The goal is to efficiently control the game and combo off to victory.

The focus of this deck is to aggressively deal damage to the opponent using efficient burn spells and aggressive creatures. The key strategy involves maintaining a fast pace of play, utilizing direct damage spells like Lightning Bolt and Incinerate to clear the way for creatures like Jackal Pup and Grim Lavamancer. Price of Progress punishes opponents for playing non-basic lands, while Sulfuric Vortex provides a constant source of damage. The deck aims to close out games quickly before the opponent has a chance to stabilize.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game using various disruptive spells and land destruction, while relying on Oath of Druids to quickly get powerful creatures onto the battlefield. The deck also utilizes efficient creatures like Terravore and Mishra's Factory to apply pressure on the opponent. By employing a mix of removal, land destruction, and powerful creatures, this deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan and take control of the game.
